## The AI Drama Studio

One prompt becomes a script, a cast and a shot list you can edit, and the same faces carry from episode one to episode forty.

### Unified workspace prompt creation flow

Answer a few questions about the story, the look and how long an episode runs, or leave any of them to it. Press build and the whole canvas comes out.

### Node editor

Every part of the episode as a box you can open: the cast, the places, every shot, the cut. Wire a face into a shot and it carries through the whole thing.

### Minicut agent

Tell it what you want in your own words. It reads the board, presses the buttons, and asks before it spends anything.

### Script editor

Write the episode and watch the shots follow. Change one line and only the shots that changed get remade.

### Agentic editor

Ask for the cut in words and it lays the clips on the timeline in the order you asked for.

## Run it from Claude Code or Codex

Point Claude Code or Codex at your work. They get the same tools our chat uses: read the board, write a script, add a shot, wire a face into it, price a generation, run it.

## One canvas. Whole episode.

Script on the left, shots on the right, the cut underneath. Change a line and only the shots that changed get regenerated.
